newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE SEEN STAYING FLAT THIS WEEK.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE SEEN STAYING FLAT THIS WEEK.

text.p: The Polish bourse was seen maintaining the horizontal trend that lasted for most of November, signalled by Friday's roughly mixed buying and selling after price fixing.
Analysts said a good sign that could keep money with stocks was this week's lighter primary market schedule, with garment maker Elpo's small public offering lasting until Thursday.
Agros , Kety , Mostostal Export , Polifarb Cieszyn , Wedel and Zywiec join the continuous trade system, putting the number of stocks there at 21. -- Steven Silber +48 22 653 9700
